frozen_by_directive: CEO directive 'Review of the external feedback + directive to coder' (2026-09-18), section 2: 'Build the DISCOVERY YIELD instrument (the cycle's main build)'
freeze_rule: This hash is pre-registered before first measurement use. ANY instrument edit produces a new version string; old measurements stand unchanged (the directive: 'Freeze hash pre-registered; any instrument edit = new version, old measurements stand').
what_it_measures: Whether the machine DISCOVERS, not whether it completes. Funnel rows are computed from each run's own durable bytes only — never self-reported values, never narratives, never summaries (Art. XXIV). The instrument is observational and never writes to the run directory it reads (Art. IX).

funnel_transitions.name: evidence_verified
funnel_transitions.note: the run's own typed verification issues (e.g. missing_source_span, mechanism_span_not_verbatim) are carried in verification_issues

funnel_transitions.name: candidates_generated_distinct
funnel_transitions.count_rule: DISTINCT only; INDETERMINATE counted separately and never as invention (Art. XLII: INDETERMINATE is a legitimate verdict, not DISTINCT); grid-advanced counts never counted (LXXVIII)

funnel_transitions.name: attack_survivors
funnel_transitions.count_rule: the primary candidate's gauntlet outcome; SURVIVOR_SELECTION.ranked non-killed entries are recorded as grid_advanced_not_counted, NEVER as survivors (the SURVIVOR_GATE resolution records that discovery-level verification is not re-run per grid candidate)
funnel_transitions.honesty_pin: attacker_provenance is always RUN_LEVEL_A2_GAUNTLET_NOT_SEALED_BAR_CALIBRATED (the R489 composition finding: the run-level A2 adversarial gauntlet is a different attacker from the sealed-bar-calibrated engine independent_attack instrument)

funnel_transitions.name: contradiction_survivors
funnel_transitions.byte_source: contradictions.blocking_count (the engine's own ADJUDICATION no_blocking_contradictions definition)

funnel_transitions.name: experimentally_discriminated
funnel_transitions.count_rule: SELECTED is not EXECUTED; v1.0.0 counts EXECUTED only via the Art. XXXVIII REAL_LOOP_VERIFIED byte state; synthetic executions never count (Art. XXXVII)

funnel_transitions.name: mutated_survivors
funnel_transitions.byte_source: stage_log IMPROVE entries: status==CHILDREN_ADMITTED + entry-level delta_real + ledger{children_admitted, children_rekilled, loop_closure} + EVOLUTION_GEN_1.json
funnel_transitions.count_rule: children admitted AND delta_real true AND re-evaluated (re_evaluated_fields from the child record: attack, independent_attack, quality, killed, physics_lifecycle — nothing inherited)

funnel_transitions.name: buyer_ready
funnel_transitions.byte_source: DISCOVERY_RELEASE.json status + package_zip + loop_verification_state + real_loop_verified + INVENTION_LINEAGE.survivor_reached
funnel_transitions.count_rule: ZIP emitted AND release in RELEASED/SHIPPED/TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY; HELD_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW is a typed drop carrying failure_reason

mid_flight_rule: A run directory without run_manifest.json is MID_FLIGHT_OR_PARTIAL_PER_LXXIV — an observation, never a terminal (the R487/R489 terminal-divergence ruling). Terminal and mid-flight rows are never collapsed in aggregates.
honesty_pins: NOVELTY_LEFT_UNRESOLVED_BY_RING_FAILURES: collision mandatory_searches.complete=false is carried on every row; novelty is never resolved from failed searches (Art. XXI.3, LXXV.2)
cost/debits typed UNKNOWN_PER_ART_XXV when no metered cost bytes exist in the run records — never invented
attacker_provenance typed on every attack_survivors transition
declared_family ABSENT_IN_DURABLE_RECORD when problem.json carries no canonical_family (the R489 submission-path gap, disclosed)

hermetic_acceptance.requirement: the instrument, run on bytes alone, reproduces the three known sealed terminals (the directive, section 2 acceptance)

case_1.name: R489 REJECTED pre-loop
case_1.expected: MID_FLIGHT typed per LXXIV (no manifest at checkpoint — the exact bytes the R489 line read); funnel first loss mechanisms_found::NO_CANDIDATES; attack KILLED with killed_dimensions [obvious_combination] (R489: '7 PASS, obvious_combination KILLED'); DEFERRED_TO_KILL_POINT recorded; no children; no release

case_2.name: R484 child-admitted
case_2.expected: TERMINAL; primary killed by exactly [engineering_infeasibility, obvious_combination, unsupported_mechanism, weak_transfer] (the R484 LOOP_CLOSURE kill dimensions); mutated_survivors count 1 with delta_real true (CHILDREN_ADMITTED — the R484 headline); release HELD, package_zip null

case_3.name: R487 terminal closure (the ruled terminal)
case_3.bytes: durable branch terminal commit 34d81fb9 (terminal:COMPLETE:ts_f0880e025e60), same run as case 1
case_3.expected: TERMINAL (INVENTION_UNDER_DEVELOPMENT — the ruled R487 terminal); mutated_survivors 1 with delta_real true and the hash transition (2964211e->5c4616c6) plus ledger loop_closure 'died -> mutated from the kill basis -> re-entered the SAME gauntlet -> 1 admitted, 0 re-killed'; release HELD_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW (TIE wall); real_loop_verified false; grid_advanced_not_counted=11 recorded but never counted
case_3.note: cases 1 and 3 are the SAME session at two byte-states — reading them reproduces the R487/R489 terminal-divergence reconciliation from bytes alone: only the terminal commit carries run_manifest.json

determinism: byte-identical output verified across two invocations on the same run bytes

durable_population_baseline.scope: all 97 run directories on runtime-state-hf at f0ef989b (86 terminal, 11 mid-flight, never collapsed)
durable_population_baseline.purpose: pre-battery baseline of the HISTORICAL population; the battery measurement itself is a separate record (R506/YIELD_MEASUREMENT.json) over fresh blind problems
durable_population_baseline.headline: buyer_ready 0/86 terminal runs; experimentally_discriminated 0/86; mutated_survivors 2/86; largest drops: evidence_verified (43x EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED + 3x typed), mechanisms_found (27x NO_CANDIDATES), attack (11x KILLED)

battery_requirements_from_directive.problems: 6-10 blind fresh problems, >=3 families, corpus-disjoint against R446/R412/R458/R492-DEV/sealed corpora (test-enforced), family-declared at submission
battery_requirements_from_directive.rules: pinned healthy ring, committed driver only, zero human bytes, freeze gates + instrument for the battery duration, NO mid-battery fixes, all attempts published incl. zeros
battery_requirements_from_directive.void_rule: a battery with re-tuned gates mid-run is void
battery_requirements_from_directive.reproducibility: a second container re-runs the yield computation from the same durable bytes and must reproduce the funnel exactly
